dedupe_keys.name: integrated natural gas and hydrogen network data set for energy system optimisation models austria 2025 2040

description: This data set gives a spatially detailed representation of Austria's natural gas and hydrogen infrastructure up to 2040, built for energy system optimisation models. It was published by Marco Quantschnig, Yannick Werner, Thomas Klatzer and Sonja Wogrin with a contribution to the EnInnov 2026 conference. The transmission network was reconstructed from public ENTSOG infrastructure maps as a topologically consistent graph and enriched with pipeline diameters, pressure levels and names by spatial matching with open data such as Global Energy Monitor; high- and medium-pressure distribution networks were added from public Austrian information with documented parameter approximations. Hydrogen repurposing and new pipelines from the Austrian Hydrogen Roadmap of AGGM are included in one topology through node splitting and connectors switched on in given years. Layers include pipelines, nodes, border points, storage, electrolysers, gas-fired power plants and hydrogen demand. Coverage is Austria down to medium pressure, 2025 to 2040. Files are GeoJSON layers on Zenodo (version 1.0, updated June 2026) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: distribution network parameters are approximations and plans may change. Simulation uses are gas and hydrogen network flow and transition planning. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
